workout.warmup: 8-10 min incline walk (3.3-3.5 mph, 6-8%). Band pull-aparts x 20. Ramp the shoulder press: 35s x 8, 45s x 5, then work at 55. Ramp the bench when you get there: 135 x 8, 165 x 3.
workout.coach_note: Back at a real gym with real equipment - first full session since Aug 3. THE ORDER CHANGE WORKED. Thursday you pressed 50 for 8, called it easy, went to 55 and got 8, 8, 9. For three straight weeks 55 was good for exactly one set when it ran behind the bench; fresh and first, you did three sets of 8+ and your best set was your last. That lift was never weak, it was just always tired. Shoulder press stays in the lead slot permanently. Today you finish the job at 55 for four sets, and there's a 60 lb test waiting at the end if it goes well. Bench holds at 185 - Thursday was dumbbells at a hotel so it doesn't count as a test. SEPARATE ISSUE, not today's problem but read it: your lower back has now complained three lower sessions running. Today is upper, which buys it two more days. We are changing the hinge before your next lower day - see my message.
workout.finisher: Skip if you're at 65 min. Otherwise 10-12 min incline walk.

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press [HEAVY] - LEAD LIFT
exercises.detail: 55 lb - 4 x 8, then optional 5th set at 60 lb
exercises.note: Stays first. Thursday: 50 x 8 easy, then 55 for 8/8/9 - and the 9 came on your LAST set, which means there was more in the tank. Today all four working sets at 55. Setup: upright back pad, DBs on thighs, kick one knee at a time. If sets 3 and 4 both come in at 8 clean, add a fifth set at 60 and take what you get - no grinding, just a read. 60 failed badly back on Jul 22 but that was in the fatigued slot, so it's an honest retest now.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press [HEAVY]
exercises.detail: 185 lb (45 bar + 70/side) - 4 x 5. No rack: Smith at 185 total / 80 per side
exercises.note: HOLD at 185. Thursday's 75 lb dumbbells at a slight incline was a good hotel improvisation but it tells us nothing about your bench, so 185 is still unconfirmed in the second slot. Complete 4x5 before adding. Ramp 135 x 8, 165 x 3. Free barbell if this location has a rack, Smith at 80/side if not - and note which one you used.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row [HEAVY]
exercises.note: Back to a real cable stack after TRX rows at the hotel. You had a clean 4x6 at 160 on Aug 2 and only stayed there because the machine had no 5 lb step. 170 today. Chest supported, strict - do NOT pull with the low back this week, it's already irritated.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown [HEAVY]
exercises.note: 150 for 6 on three sets last time you had a real machine. Close out all four today. Neutral-grip bar (the wide metal one with ring handles) if it's there. Worth noting: you got 4-5 strict pull-ups at the hotel, pronated AND neutral. That's a real number and we'll start programming them once this block winds down.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.note: Up from 37.5 - you got all 15s clean on Aug 2. Thursday you subbed lateral raises because the hotel had no cable, so this is the first real face pull since. Elbows high and wide, pull to the forehead, pause at the back.

exercises.name: Arms Superset - EZ-Bar Curl + Rope Pushdown
exercises.detail: EZ-Bar Curl 50 lb x 10 + Rope Pushdown 42.5 lb x 12 - 3 rounds
exercises.note: Thursday was incline DB curls and DB skull crushers by necessity. Back to the programmed pairing. EZ-bar at 50 gave you 10 then 12 on Jul 29. Elbows pinned on both.

exercises.name: Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Cable Crunch 66 lb x 12, Dead Bugs x 10/side, Plank Shoulder Tap x 10/side
exercises.note: Rotated off the last two circuits. All three are back-safe, which matters right now. Cable crunch at 66 if it's a standard stack, 42.5 if you're on a functional trainer. Lower back stays pressed flat on the dead bugs.
